userRequest: 로봇 대신 실제 마리오 이미지와 실제 게임 예시 이미지를 사용하고 설명과 연결되게 전부 확인해 수정
rule: Carry the recognizable character/object from inspected independent game recordings into the adjacent explanation. Attach symbols to it or explicitly map its simplified representation. A screenshot animation is an illustration, never a game measurement.

choices.choice: Keep spheres, surface/joint experiments and essential mathematical geometry; replace unrelated stand-ins and map the actual-game subject to its representation.
choices.reason: A Mario screenshot cannot replace a calculated surface normal or a control point.

choices.choice: New masters on C with the existing D review hub linking to them.
choices.reason: D has about 4.5 GiB free. C has about 22 GiB. Preserve all existing media.
